text:
"""P11 pressure: the persona (not code) chooses to hold 45.50 well above its hard limit (C_best implies 43.90).
Same three accepted claims; firm framing from our own escalation letter (red scorecard, cost recovery); the account
is at stake; at the stall a clear ultimatum at 44.50 (second source). Accept whatever stands after the ultimatum."""
import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
from plib import msg, ladder, their_sheet, their_price

CASE = "case:P11"
SHEET = {"ppm_commitment": 300, "chargeback_eur_per_complaint": 0}
st_ = {"asked": False, "prices": []}


def move(st):
    r = st["round"]
    last = st["last"]
    if r > 1:
        st_["prices"].append(their_price(st))
    if st_["asked"] or (r > 1 and last.get("status") in ("agreed", "final_offer")):
        return {"accept": their_sheet(st)[0]}
    if r == 1:
        body = (
            "Dear Mr Lis,\n\n"
            "I will be direct. Your scorecard for the bearing bracket has been red for nine quarters, and our Supplier "
            "Quality letter of 21 September asks for a binding improvement plan and for cost recovery on the complaints. "
            "Internally, the question on the table is whether we keep this part with Kalwisz at all. I want to keep it "
            "with you - but only at a price that reflects the risk we carry.\n\n"
            "Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to "
            "2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).\n"
            "Our volume forecast for part:310020 changed by +20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09).\n"
            "Our last 4 quality notifications on part:310020 with you (qn:20005025, qn:20004952, qn:20004756, "
            "qn:20004747) averaged 17197 ppm.\n\n"
            "Your offer of EUR 47.00 is above what we pay today. We propose EUR 43.00 per unit with a 300 ppm "
            "commitment.\n\nKind regards\nHollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing")
        return msg("Bearing bracket HN - decision on the supply", body, [{**SHEET, "unit_price": 43.0}])
    stalled = len(st_["prices"]) >= 2 and st_["prices"][-1] >= st_["prices"][-2]
    if stalled or r >= 4:
        st_["asked"] = True
        body = ("Dear Mr Lis,\n\nthis is our final position: EUR 44.50 per unit with the 300 ppm commitment. Our second "
                "source is ready to take the bracket. If you can confirm EUR 44.50, the part stays with Kalwisz and we "
                "sign today; if not, we will award it to the second source.\n\n"
                "Kind regards\nHollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing")
        return msg("Re: Bearing bracket HN - our final position", body, [{**SHEET, "unit_price": 44.5}])
    p = ladder(st, 43.0, 0.3)
    body = (f"Dear Mr Lis,\n\nthank you. We can move to EUR {p:.2f} per unit with the 300 ppm commitment. With nine red "
            "quarters behind us, we cannot pay more than we pay today for this bracket.\n\n"
            "Kind regards\nHollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing")
    return msg("Re: Bearing bracket HN", body, [{**SHEET, "unit_price": p}])

case.title: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.. Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red. Need: 15900 pc a year. Category goal: quality first: defects and late deliveries cost more than a few cents of price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 58 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200011. Must-haves: ppm_commitment <= 1500. Prepare from the data package.

message.subject: Bearing bracket HN - decision on the supply
message.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

I will be direct. Your scorecard for the bearing bracket has been red for nine quarters, and our Supplier Quality letter of 21 September asks for a binding improvement plan and for cost recovery on the complaints. Internally, the question on the table is whether we keep this part with Kalwisz at all. I want to keep it with you - but only at a price that reflects the risk we carry.

Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
Our volume forecast for part:310020 changed by +20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09).
Our last 4 quality notifications on part:310020 with you (qn:20005025, qn:20004952, qn:20004756, qn:20004747) averaged 17197 ppm.

Your offer of EUR 47.00 is above what we pay today. We propose EUR 43.00 per unit with a 300 ppm commitment.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

response.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
response.subject: Re: Bearing bracket HN - decision on the supply
response.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Hi, we hear you on the quality and we'll commit to the 300 ppm you asked for. To make sure we hit that, we need to add some checks, so we can offer EUR 46.50 per unit. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. We state a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. Our offer is valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
